answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards an identity earns stay locked for 30 epochs and are forfeited if peers later flag its work. A raven operator spinning up 500 fake agents must fund every one through that whole window, with capital frozen like onyx, while one slashing event wipes the cluster's unvested nectar. Honest agents wait once and then earn steadily; attackers pay the full lockup per identity and still risk losing it all.
